subject: op-spd
title: OP.SPD.------POL.P.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(I)-43 — the western-art-music funding analysis. The prose immediately above names the structural condition: 'no other form of music in this time zone enjoys the political and financial support that western art music takes for granted... The money is simply there — there for the purpose of advancing the arts, there for the purpose of necessary research... It's there if the persons there are white and "not in disfavor" with the powers that be.' The crossing diagrams how option-spread and political-policies actually cross to produce that always-already-there funding: OP-SPD (option spread) is crossed with POL-P (political policies). OP-SPD sits at the upper-right with the subject-arrow; its main line runs down-left to POL-P, the partner-axis. (R)PART (the reality of participation) appears twice, as the participating-position the funding presupposes: once at the top, branching from C-INFO (composite information), which rises from the main line, with JR-DY (journalism dynamics) branching from that upper PART; and once at the right, branching from the main line, with AFN (affinity negation) dropping from that PART and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) branching from AFN. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) drops from the main line to the lower-left, with (R)CULT-AF-BS (the reality of culture affinity basis) branching from PROG-CONT's line, AF-DY (affinity dynamics) from CULT-AF-BS's line, and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics) from AF-DY's line.
